content:
Here’s *The Iliad* summarized in emojis:

👑💥🏛️ (King Agamemnon angers Achilles)
😡🔥⚔️ (Achilles rages, refuses to fight)
👨💪🛡️ (Hector leads Troy, fights bravely)
😢👶🏹 (Patroclus dies in Achilles’ armor)
😭🔥⚔️ (Achilles returns, kills Hector)
🐴🏙️🔥 (Trojan Horse? No—just Hector’s body dragged)
👴😢🏛️ (King Priam begs for Hector’s body)
⚰️🕊️ (Hector’s funeral, war still rages)

Bonus: The *real* Trojan Horse comes later in the *Odyssey*! 🐴💣🏛️
